book.name: 2 Timoti
book.title: TIMOTI AE ISA PORO KAENTIYE (TARA YAGANE)

content: Mono yuga puma miyo
Pigoya, Karaisiti Isu aeba aoganta kinape purinta kinape a'yigitatakiye. Piyama, aeba tumpa aborama kabiratakenaenaga napima ae aobipe Koti nkaobipe naeba esegi kamanapa mayama ugamuwe:

Kaeba mono kamana'wapa uma aborao. Piya, wasanami abikena piginape, kampa abikena piginapeba a'ya'ma yaga kaeba yokege puma monopa uma aborao. Kaeba esegi kamana uma intawamapa aseyo puwaitamagina, aguntaenawaika kamana uwaitamagina, igupa asiwaitagini Kotipa aegaraiyo. Piyama, a'ya'ma yagaba pasema yoga puwaitama aogima ibubasanao.
Piya, ka kana arosakanapa, wasanamipa arupu kamana maesanagaba kampa ibikiye. Kampaye. Piyama, igeba igebinti antunta uwakena tisa kina aki puma iba pigini, igebi nkiyobi kamanapa nigi'ma ukibewe.
Aibigini, igeba taga kamana abikenagaba ikabitama, tonarona a'yugu amani kamana ki'i nasikibewe.
We, kaeba kampaye. A'ya'ma yaga kaega parutu kagi napiyo. Kaeba kuntaenaba aesagabo. Eya, aogi kamanapa aborakena yugaba puma, mono yugagampa nkau'pa aogima aborano.
Poro kana'wapa arosantiye
Pigoya, nae nau Kotiti muta atakena kanapa arosasu pegi, mampaba atakena puwe.
Naeba agasigasi pukenaenaba aogima puntuwe. Eya, naeba ke'nempa nkatuta ago kanamagi, namatiti'enanempa kampa antage potauwe.

Piya, ibaba arupuyenama nkantota'ena taminonki natakena yokege pumagina, agogo yagaba Wa'ega, arupu kamana ukena yagaramaba, aeba namikiye. We, nae'mana nane. A'ya'ma ae irosakibitaka ibugai kina, igeke kaga imikiye.
Nagarikena kamanane
Pigoya, kaeba karu'ena naetiba kanao.
Piya, Timasiba aeba mampabisaenaga abugaogana nagasima Tesaronaika kumati wantiye. Keresenisiba aeba kanara puma Karesiya mari waogana, Taitasiba aeba Tarimesiya mari wantiye.
We, Aruku ae abintowapa naege mintiye. Piya, kaeba Makapa aba puregirisi kanaisigina, aeba kanara yogaba ampa nao'maeyano.
Naeba Tikikasipa otauwagana aeba Epesasi kumati wantiye.
We, naeba e'ero mu'mu kainepa Torowasi kumata Kapasi ntamapi atantogana, kaeba kanakena puntanapa, maentana purite kanantana, esa'nepe, we, yaga au'arirasa pumaranta isapa kaga maete kanao.
Aresanta aeba kapa yugawa pukena yagara, aeba tabera ata punatantiye. Aintiba Wa'egawamaba antota'enaba a'wae pomeno.
We, aeba kamanatepa tabera kama puratantegina, kaegeba aekaba kabima miyo.
Pigoya, maru'enaba kamana unatauguni, wasanamiba kampa nao'maema a'ya'ma kina'miba nagaintawe. We, naeba Kotiti nunamu yokini, pi nkaibo'enawaikaba kamanapa a-nkuwaitano.

Pigoya, Wa'egawama nagora asimagina esegiyenaba namima nao'maeyoga, naeba kanara aogi kamana'ama nkago uma aborauwagini, a'ya'ma namu'isa kina'miba abintawe. Eya, Kotiba araiyoniwama nkawamupisa apa'natantisa puma nau'intiye.
Piyama, Wa'egawamaba a'ya'ma aguntaenabisa apa'natamagina, mantawama kabiratakenaenawapi ubasikenaga nau'ikiye. We, ae agega'eba asagayuyaba miyeno. Tagane.
Pigoya, Pirisikabe Akurabe Onisiporasi tunkape: Aya pewe uritayema, uwaimo.
Pigoya, Erasitasiba aeba Korinti kumata pabita mintogana, Toropimasipa yoni nkaboga aepa Mairitasi kumata atauwagana mintantiye.
We, kamparaga esiba yaga aborakiya, kaeba karu'ena naeti kanao. Pigoya, Yuburasibe Putenisibe Arainasibe Korotiyabe a'ya'ma mono kina'mibe kaga: Aya pene, yewe.
Wa'egawamaba kauma kagukampage miyeno. Awagaenawampaba tigeti waima waiyeno.
